'''Terkle's Terrors''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Hamar-Chaktak]] contracted the mercenaries through his company, [[Cargo Consolidated, Inc.]], to guard the [[B-12 Bacta Transport]] ''[[Theta 2Y]]''.<ref name="BH">{{WEGCite|story=The Bacta Heist|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
